Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Blizzard II: Deals ice damage with a potency of 300 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to ice.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Occult Fire II and Occult Thunder II.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Fire II: Deals fire damage with a potency of 300 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to fire.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Occult Blizzard II and Occult Thunder II.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Libra: Discern the elemental affinity of enemies, increasing the potency of elemental attacks that exploit their weaknesses.</br>Duration: 120s
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Thunder II: Deals lightning damage with a potency of 300 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to lightning.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Occult Fire II and Occult Blizzard II.
Class_Trait_Desc_Dualcast: Grants the effect of Dualcast upon casting any spell with a cast time. While under the effect of Dualcast, your next spell will require no time to cast. Effect is canceled upon execution of any action other than an ability. Auto-attacks do not cancel effect.</br>Duration: 15s
